verdict.rationale: Anytype documents Queries that assemble results "instantly" from user-defined criteria (anytype-docs-8, anytype-docs-21), and it is offline-first with all content stored locally (anytype-docs-29, anytype-docs-71), so filtered retrieval works offline. However, no in-app full-text search is documented, and the specific filter dimensions (tags, properties, paths) are not spelled out. Search is mentioned only via the API and agent skill, not as a user-facing feature (anytype-docs-18). Missing for 10: documented in-app full-text search, explicit filtering by tags, properties and paths, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and offline search.
